sam: Heads-up — PR #3124 modifies the routing policy and cache TTL heuristics. Can someone sanity-check the cost/perf tradeoff? https://git.redwood/infra/pr/3124 :wave:

sam: TL;DR: change routes so longer sequences go to model-v2-quant, reduce KV cache TTL from 15m -> 3m for high-churn users, and add a fallback to model-v1 if quantized nodes are saturated.

sam: main concern is we might increase token compute (more cold starts) and spike p95 latency for certain flows. I ran a small sim locally, rough numbers in the PR description.

tara: I can take a look — giving 2hrs. Do we have perf bench results from the staging canary?

sam: no full canary yet, just unit sims. plan was to roll canary after review. I attached the local sim snippet in the PR.

kevin: Quick thought: dropping TTL to 3m might kill cache hit rate for bursty orgs. Can you add a sampling histogram to the metrics to check prefix reuse? If hit rate falls <70% we should keep a higher TTL or add per-tenant override.

mira: re: routing — if we route by sequence length only we could misclassify messages that are short but require high-recall tokens. Suggest adding a cheap classifier to detect “high-cost” prompts and route by cost-score + length. Small extra CPU but reduces rollout risk.

sam: good points. I can add a metric for prefix reuse and a per-tenant TTL override flag. For classifier idea, would that be a model-based call or heuristic?

mira: start heuristic: check for special tokens / prompt templates (regex). If we see false positives we can replace with a micro-model later.

tara: Also add a feature flag gate for the routing change so we can canary per-region. If the canary spikes latency we auto-disable routing.

kevin: can we also expose an "eviction pressure" metric (kv_evictions/sec) so SRE can correlate with p50/p95? That'll make post-rollout triage easier.

sam: will add metrics: prefix_reuse_ratio, kv_evictions_per_sec, route_fallback_rate. I'll update the PR.

ops-bot: canary-deploy: created canary job redwood-inference/canary/3124 in us-west-2 — status: queued. :robot_face:

tara: ok let me know when canary runs. If you can add the per-tenant override and the feature flag in the same PR that helps rollback. Small nit: include a one-line cost delta estimate in the PR description (tokens/hr, $/hr), SRE wants that up front.

sam: noted. I'll push edits tonight and ping when canary finishes. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
